description: Retrieval-verification dataset for the relay namespace: the keyless cross-chain bridge quote and execute pair, and the only route Vex has to or from Robinhood Chain (4663). Blind rows describe the bridging outcome without naming the brand; protocol-aware rows name it.

how much USDG arrives and how long does it take if I move 250 USDG off Robinhood Chain to Base
estimate the bridging fee and destination amount for sending VIRTUAL to chain 4663 before I commit
get a Relay bridge quote for 0.1 ETH from Arbitrum into Robinhood Chain
price a Relay route to a chain Khalani cannot reach and show the slippage and time estimate
actually move 300 USDC from Base onto Robinhood Chain now so I can fund trading there
sign and broadcast the bridge that takes my 0.4 ETH out of Robinhood Chain back to Ethereum mainnet
execute the Relay bridge I just priced and send the 150 USDG across to Robinhood Chain
run the Relay transfer for real, spending funds from my wallet, to bring VIRTUAL onto chain 4663
quote a Relay bridge of 0.2 ETH into Robinhood Chain and then carry it out once the numbers look fine
check what 1000 USDC would become on the other chain and then perform the transfer to Robinhood Chain
